Economy · India

Congress disputes official GDP growth figures, citing job and investment concerns

India's Congress party has labelled the reported 7.8% GDP growth as a "Greatly Distorted Picture." The party questioned the figures, raising concerns about job creation and investment levels. Prime Minister Narendra Modi, however, described the same growth rate as a "herculean feat." The differing interpretations highlight a political debate over the economic data.
